description: This is a PHP source file defining functions related to installing and configuring features for SuiteCRM, including setting up hooks, templates, and configurations for the AdvancedOpenPortal module.

methods.name: install_aop
methods.description: Main function to install AdvancedOpenPortal features, configure settings, create templates, and set up hooks.

methods.name: installAOPHooks
methods.description: Sets up various logic hooks for modules such as Contacts, Cases, and Emails.

methods.name: getTemplates
methods.description: Returns an array of predefined email templates used within the module.
